title: Confidentiality and information sharing
summary: Whether personal information is kept safe and shared only through safe channels, including staff phones and messaging apps.
whenToUse: Every year, after a data breach, or when staff use their own phones for work.

statements.focus: Data protection policy, breach log and how records and devices are kept secure.
Privacy respected: people’s details not discussed or shared where others can see.
Data protection training, and staff using approved apps rather than personal messaging groups.
Information shared with other professionals safely and only when needed.
